description: ***Amendment to the solicitation has been made to include all answers in the Q and A document that will be posted in SAM.Gov****THIS REQUIREMENT IS ONLY FOR SEAPORT MAC HOLDERS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSAL AND THE SOLICIATION NUMBER IN THIS SYSTEM HAD TO BE CHANGED TO N3904026R0003 DUE TO A GLITCH, THE ACTUAL SOLICIATION NUMBER AS YOU WILL SEE ON ALL DOCUMENTION IS N3904026R0002* Portsmouth Naval Shipyard (PNS) has a requirement for Receipt Inspectors to support the Receipt Inspection Services within the Quality Assurance (QA) Department.  Receipt Inspection provides assurance that the materials procured for use on Naval Nuclear Submarines meet the required and specified requirements before being issued.
